provenance.provenance_note:
# Frozen implementation/control build artifacts

Session `ses_eb24f98a3ffewdVqa9lao6tXQu`, before handing performance tooling to
the separately commissioned Sol high agent. Do not overwrite these executables.
`identity.json` records hashes and matches to the original timing/trace logs.

Semantic candidates: baseline `fd277144`, initial checked implementation
`8658b6da`, lazy-name candidate `243be8e2`; final comment/contract checkpoint
`fa91c18a`, with evidence checkpoint `a6f577d9`. Configured compiler is Rust
1.101.0-nightly 822182db4, release default, library `parallel` only. Candidate
runner's `checks` feature is harness-only. No diagnostics instrumentation.

The timed `checked-live` executables were subsequently rebuilt to add a
clean-only tracing command and harden an untimed reserved-name setup operation.
Their original timing hashes/source remain in `live-identity.json` and the
tracked `perf/results/checked/live-bench.rs`. Current frozen live executables are
the trace variants, matched to `syscalls-live-identity.json`, not falsely labeled
as the original timed bytes. The frozen candidate and initial benchmark
executables match their timing identities. The baseline benchmark was also
rebuilt when candidate-only benchmark syntax changed; its current bytes match
the delta-syscall experiment rather than the older timing hash. Refer to the
explicit matches in `identity.json`; never infer byte identity from a filename.
The original baseline experiment source/hash are retained. The source snapshots here
are for reproduction/provenance, not new product runners.

[package]
name = "diff-dirs-perf-runner"
version = "0.0.0"
edition.workspace = true
publish = false
build = "build.rs"

[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
sha2 = "0.10"

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"
sampling: seeded mirrored blocks; no warmup samples; each child initializes/warms outside its API timer
scope: API timer from checked-bench; process_ns includes startup, pool, untimed initialization; no cache dropping
